insurance.standard_rule: $250,000 per depositor, per FDIC-insured bank, per ownership category; coverage is automatic for deposit accounts at an FDIC-insured bank.
insurance.trust_formula: # owners x # beneficiaries x $250,000 = amount insured, not to exceed $1,250,000 per owner for all trust accounts
insurance.joint_rule: Each co-owner's shares of every joint account at the same insured bank are added together and insured up to $250,000.
insurance.retirement_rule: Certain retirement accounts (IRAs, self-directed 401k/profit-sharing, Keogh, 457) owned by the same person at the same bank are added together and insured up to $250,000.

structures.structure: Joint savings account (2 owners), one bank
Single-owner account with 3 POD beneficiaries, one bank
Single-owner account with 5 POD beneficiaries, one bank
structures.formula: 1 owner x 5 beneficiaries x $250,000 (equals the $1,250,000 per-owner trust cap)

structures.structure: Single-owner accounts at 5 different FDIC-insured banks
